name: splitwiser
description: Free forever, open-source group expense splitter. Zero friction, installable PWA, and no paywalls. Built for the things we share.

scripts.db:migrate:remote: set -a && [ -f .env ] && . ./.env && set +a && export CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN="${CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN:-$TF_VAR_cloudflare_app_api_token}" CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID="${CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID:-$TF_VAR_cloudflare_app_account_id}" && pnpm --filter api db:migrate:remote
scripts.check: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build
scripts.deploy:landing: set -a && [ -f .env ] && . ./.env && set +a && export CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN="${CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN:-$TF_VAR_cloudflare_app_api_token}" CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID="${CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID:-$TF_VAR_cloudflare_app_account_id}" && pnpm --filter landing build && wrangler pages deploy apps/landing/dist --project-name splitwiser-landing-production --branch main
scripts.deploy:dashboard: set -a && [ -f .env ] && . ./.env && set +a && export CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN="${CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN:-$TF_VAR_cloudflare_app_api_token}" CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID="${CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID:-$TF_VAR_cloudflare_app_account_id}" && pnpm --filter dashboard build && wrangler pages deploy apps/dashboard/dist --project-name splitwiser-dashboard-production --branch main
scripts.deploy:api: set -a && [ -f .env ] && . ./.env && set +a && export CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN="${CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN:-$TF_VAR_cloudflare_app_api_token}" CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID="${CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID:-$TF_VAR_cloudflare_app_account_id}" && pnpm db:migrate:remote && wrangler deploy --config workers/api/wrangler.jsonc
